```yaml
name: Social Copy Generator

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited]

jobs:
  post_initial_comment:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.action == 'opened'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Post initial comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const commentBody = `
**Social Copy Generator**

- [ ] Generate social media copies

*This comment is managed by the Social Copy Generator bot. Check the box to generate content. After generation, the box will change to "Regenerate".*
`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: commentBody
            });

  generate_social_copies:
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
      (github.event.action == 'created' || github.event.action == 'edited') &&
      (
        github.event.comment.body.includes('Generate social media copies') ||
        github.event.comment.body.includes('Regenerate')
      ) &&
      github.event.comment.body.includes('[x]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      COMMENT_ID: ${{ github.event.comment.id }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Update comment to "Generating..."
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const commentId = process.env.COMMENT_ID;
            const newBody = `
**Social Copy Generator**

- [ ] Generating...

*Please wait while the content is being generated.*`;
            await github.issues.updateComment({
              comment_id: commentId,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: newBody
            });

      - name: Run Claude Code to generate copies
        id: generate
        run: |
          # Simulate Claude Code call
          echo "twitter: This is a tweet about the PR." > twitter.txt
          echo "linkedin: This is a LinkedIn post about the PR." > linkedin.txt
          echo "blog: This is a blog post about the PR." > blog.txt
          echo "::set-output name=twitter::$(cat twitter.txt)"
          echo "::set-output name=linkedin::$(cat linkedin.txt)"
          echo "::set-output name=blog::$(cat blog.txt)"

      - name: Update comment with results
        if: success()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          TWITTER: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.twitter }}
          LINKEDIN: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.linkedin }}
          BLOG: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.blog }}
        with:
          script: |
            const commentId = process.env.COMMENT_ID;
            const newBody = `
**Social Copy Generator**

- [ ] Regenerate

**Twitter/X**
${process.env.TWITTER}

**LinkedIn**
${process.env.LINKEDIN}

**Blog Post**
${process.env.BLOG}
`;
            await github.issues.updateComment({
              comment_id: commentId,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: newBody
            });

      - name: Update comment with error
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const commentId = process.env.COMMENT_ID;
            const logUrl = `${process.env.GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID}`;
            const newBody = `
**Social Copy Generator**

- [ ] Regenerate

**Error**
An error occurred while generating the social copies. Please check the workflow logs for details.

[View logs](${logUrl})
`;
            await github.issues.updateComment({
              comment_id: commentId,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: newBody
            });
```
